top_creatures.label: Ambush monster with hidden nameplate
top_creatures.why: The player learns its name only when it moves; a hidden-name flag makes it a surprise.
top_creatures.change: visible tell (shimmering chest) and reveal on first hit

top_creatures.label: Oversized monster scale path
top_creatures.why: Three giant kinds share one scale path with large height and scale numbers, plus a default for everything else.
top_creatures.keep: scale as a per-kind data field with a default
top_creatures.change: own silhouette and a ground-shake stomp

top_creatures.label: Invisible-body attacker
top_creatures.why: A collision-only attacker that is felt, not seen.

top_creatures.label: Posed tentacle object

looks.label: Day-night tint with a vision floor
looks.technique: light = clamp(directional x ambient + max(ambient x day-night tint, vision colour) + vertex light + realtime light + global ambient, 0, 1)

looks.label: Per-object sunlight value
looks.technique: single-colour objects take one ambient number instead of per-vertex colour (sentinel -1 means vertex-coloured)

looks.label: Vertex-colour bake applied on first visible
looks.technique: colours are applied in OnBecameVisible, so off-screen objects cost nothing

looks.label: Invisible collision material
looks.technique: unlit pass returns a zero colour, so the mesh draws nothing; collision is separate

looks.label: Sky anchored to camera with day length as data
looks.technique: sky follows the camera with a fixed rotation; a 4 s clip plays at speed 4 divided by seconds per day

looks.label: Per-slot tint via property block
looks.technique: colour is set on every material that is not the base mesh material, without a new material

looks.label: Baked 27-key volume rolloff
looks.technique: a fixed curve over normalised distance, one per sound class

originals.name: Ambush mimic
originals.idea: A creature with a hidden nameplate until it hits, then a reveal.
originals.change: visual tell and reveal; own silhouette

originals.name: Oversized brute
originals.idea: A giant kind on a per-kind scale path with a ground-shake stomp.

originals.name: Border-crossfaded zone music
originals.idea: Zone music that crossfades at borders with a priority table (dungeon over hub over zone).
originals.keep: trigger-owned cue and the day and night split
originals.change: 2 to 3 second crossfade driven by the fade data

originals.name: Race sound set with variant rows
originals.idea: A base sound row per race, copied variants keyed by gender, with a pool that avoids repeats.
originals.change: own sound design and a no-repeat pool

originals.name: Vision-floor night
originals.idea: Night lighting with a floor so the scene never goes black.

originals.name: Boat platform
originals.idea: A moving boat as a traversal platform with its own scale.
originals.keep: moving platform with its own scale

originals.name: Race-gated loot mask
originals.idea: Items restricted by a 16-flag bitmask, on one character ledger.
